title: Enter got accounts and API keys
summary:
Enter gained self-service account tools while text routing and generation limits got a careful tune-up.

GitHub sign-in and a dashboard let users create, list and delete API keys, and see their Polar customer meter balance. API proxy routes and generation tracking were added behind those flows.

`openai-large` now resolves to GPT-5 Nano rather than GPT-4.1. Requests gained backend-model-ID aliases for Mistral Small 3.1 24B and DeepSeek R1 0528. Mistral Small 2402 Romance Companion was unhidden, moved to the flower tier, and given two aliases.

Text requests now respect each model’s configured `max_tokens` ceiling, falling back to the global limit when needed. `openai-large` requests are capped at 1024 tokens; Flux’s maximum side length is 768, and Azure GPT-4.1’s token-limit settings are 512. Images requested without dimensions now use `sideLength` for both width and height.

A modular rewrite reorganized the request pipeline. Queue-full and text-service logs gained user context, 429s got separate logging, and two text-transform import casing issues were corrected. Error response JSON stayed the same.
